body_text:
The embedding $\iota : \mathbb{Z} \hookrightarrow \mathbb{Q}$
identifies each integer $a$ with $a/1$. The field of fractions
$\mathbb{Q}$ satisfies a universal property: if $F$ is any field
and $\varphi : \mathbb{Z} \to F$ is a non-trivial ring
homomorphism, there exists a unique field homomorphism
$\widetilde{\varphi} : \mathbb{Q} \to F$ such that
$\widetilde{\varphi} \circ \iota = \varphi$. Specifically,
$\widetilde{\varphi}(a/b) = \varphi(a) \cdot \varphi(b)^{-1}$.
Thus $\mathbb{Q}$ is the initial object in the category of fields
of characteristic zero.
